What's Changed

## New Features

- Add persistent SQLite throughput statistics with incremental Caddy log ingestion.
- Add live dashboard throughput view with per-webhost filtering and configurable periods.

## Optimizations

- Add throughput chart hover crosshair with exact timestamp and upload/download values.
- Monitor `modernc.org/sqlite` for upstream version updates alongside Caddy, Geo-IP, and Go.
